---
description: "Use when editing the local memory workspace's interface, interaction feedback, accessibility, or visual styling."
applyTo: "afterevidence/static/**"
---

Keep the interface local-first, quiet, and evidence-focused. Preserve native controls,
source links, explicit model failures, and the distinction between assertions,
interpretations, rule plans, and research results.

Use the platform system font, clear hierarchy, restrained surfaces, and existing CSS
tokens. Keep primary interactive targets at least 44 CSS pixels high. Add visible
keyboard focus, adequate contrast, and layouts that survive narrow screens and zoom.

Motion must explain state or acknowledge input, not decorate data. Do not animate
frequently refreshed evidence, counters, or keyboard navigation. Use named CSS
properties, hover-capability gating, and reduced-motion/transparency variants.
Do not install an animation library for a color transition or a spinner.

These are original project conventions informed by Emil Kowalski's Apple-design
and animation guidance, not copied skill text or Apple product branding.
